subject: CTO last-minute add — propose compacting + backup coverage
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sally Park <sally@brightworks.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: CTO last-minute add — propose compacting + backup coverage

Hi Sally — quick one. Daniel (CTO) just pinged that he'd like to join our walkthrough on Wednesday but he lands late and is only available for the first 30–40 minutes before a leadership sync.

Options I can offer right now:
- Compact the session to a 40-minute "exec brief" covering key value props + 2 live demos, then schedule a 60-minute deep-dive later this week for the product team.
- Move the session 30 minutes earlier so Daniel can be present for the tail end (if that works with your schedule).
- Keep the original time; we run full demo and have Vivek standby as a sponsor parachute to handle any exec questions if Daniel can't join.

We're attaching the latest deck (demo-deck-v3.pdf) — the compact brief would slice out the deep benchmarking section and surface the architecture + ROI slides first.

Can you tell me which option you'd prefer and whether Daniel needs intro slides for context? If you confirm a preference, I'll send an updated calendar invite and a short handoff plan.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
[dylan_brooks@redwood.com]

Attachments: demo-deck-v3.pdf (slide deck, v3)

From: Sally Park <sally@brightworks.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CTO last-minute add — propose compacting + backup coverage

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the options. Daniel can join for about 20 minutes at the start of the call (he's scheduled into back-to-back travel checks), so the only workable approach on our side is to run the exec highlights first (20 min) then move into the deeper demo for product & infra folks.

If you can put the high-level business outcomes and the two most compelling live demos up front, Daniel will stay for that. He doesn't need extra intro slides — just the customer problem, ROI, and one architecture slide.

We can also shift the meeting 15 minutes earlier (from 10:00 to 09:45 PT) if that helps you preserve time for the deep dive afterward. Either way, please send an updated invite — Daniel will be on the line from the airport.

Sally
Director, Product — BrightWorks
sally@brightworks.com

Thanks — we can do the "exec first, deep-dive after" flow. Practical runbook from our side (quick):
- 09:45–10:05 PT: Executive brief (Dylan front, 2 demos: latencies & TCO sketch).
- 10:05–10:50 PT: Deep technical session (Laura + engineering) for product/infra.
- Backup: Vivek will be on the line for any strategic/contractual questions if Daniel drops early.

Action items for us before Wednesday:
- Dylan: lead the exec brief and call out the ROI slide at 6 minutes in.
- Laura: prepare the deep-dive run-through + one architecture deep-dive slide.
- Me: prep a 1-page "sponsor handback" checklist to send right before the call (attached: sponsor-handback-checklist.md).

Dylan — I can shorten a few benchmarking slides to keep the exec brief tight. Are you ok with shifting 15 minutes earlier (09:45) or do we want to keep the original 10:00 and compress to 40 minutes? I'm flexible but prefer the earlier slot to avoid rushing the deep-dive.

Kimberly Park

Notes for the call:
- Deck: demo-deck-v3.pdf (we'll open to slide 4 for the ROI callout at ~6 minutes).
- Sponsor handback: I'll drop Kimberly's checklist in the chat at 09:58 in case Daniel needs to pull out.
- Backup: Vivek will cover any procurement/contract questions — Vivek, flag if we need to prep any pricing slides.

Daniel — thanks for making time while traveling. We'll queue the 2 live demos up front so you see the outcomes early.

See you all Wednesday — I'll send the final invite and a 2-minute pre-brief by EOD.
